//: Starter config. Core (immutable, highest) > Org > Project > Role > User (lowest). The stricter rule wins on any conflict. Claude Code loads these through the imports in CLAUDE.md; other tools read this file as the map.

core.description: The framework itself (git submodule or copy). Never edit in place.

org.description: Organization rules: approved tools, data classes, contacts

project.description: Project rules: stack, environments, definition of done

user.description: Each person's role selection and preferences (cannot weaken rules)

role.description: Role rules. Each person selects one in their user file. Loads after Project, before User.

precedence_note: Core (immutable, always highest) > Org > Project > Role > User (lowest). If any conflict, the stricter rule wins.
credential_storage: [secrets manager or vault your organization uses]
